Sensitive information mode (all forms)
For sites where visitors might type private details (for example health information). Adds a required consent box and a note above the submit button on this form and on every Form section (each section can turn it off). Home Page
Hero banner and page section builder.
Home Page
When off, the built-in Home page is hidden from the menu, footer and search, and anyone who would land on it (the logo, the bare address) opens another page instead. You can keep editing it here.
Used when the Home page is off. Pages that are links, hidden group headers or switched off can't be picked.
"On this page" jump links
A row of chips between the hero / stats bar and the first section that jump to each section with a # anchor and a heading or label. Shown when at least 2 sections are included ("Leave out of the jump links" on a section removes its chip).
Stick under the header while scrolling

Backgrounds — where each color shows up
Header & Footer
The top bar, the footer and the phone menu. In the Aura layout it is also the page background behind every section.
Light sections
The default section background.
Alt sections
Alternating sections, so neighbors don’t blend together.
Dark sections
Bold sections with light text. Buttons use this color for their text.

Accent (Hover & Labels)

Outline-button borders and a few hover backgrounds. Usually a little lighter than Dark Background. (Was “Dark Background (Light Variant)”.)
Headings and text on Dark sections, the header, footer and phone menu (softer text uses it at lower strength). Usually white.
Accent-colored small text (labels, dates, links) on Light and Alt backgrounds. Blank = the Accent darkened just enough to read: .

▼
Default subpages open in main navigation
Default subpages open in footer navigation
Always solid header (no transparent-over-hero effect)
Nav / Footer CTA Button

📌 Quick Actions
▼
A bar of big buttons pinned to the bottom of the screen on phones — for example 📞 Call · 📅 Book · 🔐 Portal. It moves out of the way while the menu, search, a popup or the PIN pad is open.
Show the Quick Actions bar
Also show on desktop (as a floating bar)
2–4 actions work best. Keep labels short (one or two words). "Primary" fills the button with your accent color — use it for the most important action.
📣 Announcement Strip
▼
A thin strip across the very top of the site for short, important information — for example an after-hours line, holiday hours, or "In an emergency call 911".
Show the announcement strip
Keep it to one short sentence. Links below are added after the text.
Links (up to 3)
The strip stays one line on phones. The ticker only moves when the text doesn't fit, pauses when touched, and stays still for visitors who turn off motion.
Visitors can close it (×)
0 = until the browser is closed. Changing the text shows it again.
Leave all unticked to show it on every page.
⚖️ Footer & Legal
Footer & Legal
The links in the footer's bottom row, and the built-in Privacy Policy page.
🔗 Footer Legal Links
▼
Links in the very bottom row of the footer, next to the copyright — for example Privacy Policy · Notice of Privacy Practices · Accessibility · Terms. Leave empty to keep the standard Privacy Policy and Contact links.
Link to the built-in Privacy page by choosing Internal Page → Privacy Policy. Documents (a PDF notice, for example) can use File / Document.
🔒 Privacy Policy Page
▼
Edit the site's Privacy Policy page. Anything left blank keeps the built-in wording.
You can type {email}, {phone} or {firmName} — the site fills them in from your first location / business info. Have your policy reviewed for your field (for example HIPAA for medical offices).

Add business details for search engines
Adds hidden JSON-LD to the page, built from Business Info, Locations (address, phone, hours, coordinates), your logo and social links. It helps search engines show your hours, phone and map. Nothing visible changes.
The closest schema.org type. Pick from the list or type another.
Comma-separated schema.org names, e.g. Obstetric, Gynecologic, Pediatric, Dermatology, Cardiovascular, PrimaryCare.

📚 Library

      
Library

      
Documents for your site: standards, cheat sheets, forms, links. They’re saved in their own file, library.js, separate from config.js. Show them with the 📊 Document Library section; site search finds them too.

      

        
        
        
        
        
      

      

      

      

    


    
    

      
📅 Events

      
Events

      
Events, categories and holiday packs for your site. They’re saved in their own file, events.js, separate from config.js and library.js. Show them with the 📊 Calendar and 📊 Events sections.

      

        
        
        
        
      

      

      

    


    
    

      
🔗 Menu Links

      
Menu Links

      
The header and footer menu: Home, links and sub-links. They’re saved in their own file, navigation.js, which every copy of your site can share, so you change the menu once. Once the file is in your folder it replaces the menu built from each page’s own settings.

📤 Export

      
Export Configuration

      
Download your config.js file to deploy alongside your website.

      

        

          
📤 config.js Preview

          ▼
        

        

          

            
            
          

          
Click "Refresh Preview" to see your config.js

        

      

      

        

          
📂 Deployment Instructions

          ▼
        

        

          
1. Use Live Preview (the eye icon in the top bar) to see changes beside the editor, or the arrow icon next to it to open the site in a new tab.

          
2. Click Export config.js to download your configuration file.

          
3. Place config.js in the same folder as index.html.

          
4. Reload your website — all changes appear automatically.
